verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped or least-privilege API keys. The only key-creation instruction shown selects a "Full-Access Key", and no restricted or read-only key type is described. Custom MCP servers that expose only selected tools are a related but different control: they limit the tool surface, not the scope of the credential itself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
